d:
Ab zyada-se-zyada purush top modal banne ka sapna dekh rahe hain. muqabla behad kara hai. haimbarg ki modal ekedmi jaisi jaghon par ubharte modals ko kraish kors men modling ki buniyadi baten sikhaee jati hain.
Jo sachmuch saphal hote hain, ve rozana hazaron yuro kama sakte hain aur bare hordings par apni tasvir dekh sakte hain. haimbarg ki modalverk ejensi ki modal ekedmi men yuvaon ko poz karna, kaimre ke samne kam karna aur ranve par sadhe andaz men chalna sikhaya jata hai.
